title: Complete New Matter Intake — Civil Litigation, Appeals, Transactional, Business & Estate
description: Progressive save-and-resume intake. The data contract remains flat and field IDs remain stable; conditional sections control what the submitter sees and hidden required fields are not enforced.

conventions.id_policy: snake_case, section-prefixed where ambiguity is possible. IDs are immutable across versions.
conventions.group_semantics: type=group with repeats=true renders as a repeating block; answers stored as an array of objects keyed by subfield id.
conventions.show_if_semantics: {field, op, value}. op is one of: eq, ne, in, not_in, contains, is_true, is_false, any_of. Absent show_if = always shown.
conventions.required_semantics: required=true is enforced only when the field is visible. required_if uses the normalized {field, op, value} contract and is enforced only when its condition is met.
conventions.unanswered: Store explicit null plus a status of 'unknown' | 'not_applicable' | 'to_be_provided' rather than an empty string, so downstream agents can distinguish 'no' from 'not asked'.
conventions.internal_only_semantics: internal_only=true is populated by the Legal Agent OS and never rendered as a submitter input.
conventions.document_type_semantics: type=document_type resolves options from contracts/document-output-types.sc.v1.json and stores the stable document code.

sections.title: 12. Research Parameters & Verification
sections.purpose: Controls authority selection and the citation-verification standard.

fields.label: Citation verification level
options: Standard — citations confirmed to exist and match the proposition
High — every citation retrieved in full text, every quotation checked verbatim against the source, and subsequent history checked

fields.help: Anything intended for filing should use the highest level. No authority is cited unless it has been retrieved and read.

fields.label: Adverse authority known to you
fields.help: Controlling adverse authority generally must be disclosed. Identify it so it can be addressed rather than discovered by the court.

fields.label: Prior research or memoranda on this issue

sections.title: 18. Internal Use Only
sections.purpose: Populated by the system, not the submitter.

fields.label: QC tier
options: Tier 4 — attorney review required before release

validation_gates.rule: No substantive deliverable is released while the internal adverse-party and engagement screen is unresolved.
accuracy_attestation, authority_attestation, and review_attestation must all be true before work begins.
Either hard_deadline and its source fields are supplied, or no_external_deadline is true. internal_target_date is always required. Unverified external deadlines are flagged before work is scheduled.
services_requested and services_requested_detail are both required; at least one entry in deliverables is required.
If submitter_role is pro se, pro_se_acknowledgment and no_legal_advice_attestation must both be true.
If any deliverable is destined for a court, verification_level must be 'High' or 'Court filing' and citator_required must be true.

deliverable_prerequisites._note: Minimum fields an agent must have populated before it can produce each deliverable class. Missing entries should trigger a targeted clarification request rather than a guess.
